title: Update The Blind Box Opening Results
breadcrumb: Update The Blind Box Opening Results
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-10
html:
Path: /order/202605/orders/blind_box_result/callback

Method: [POST]

Function Description

After the merchant completes blind box opening in a live room, use this callback to send the opening results for an order back to the platform. The request supports two result shapes: blind_box_results contains one unboxed product per item, while blind_batch_box_results groups one or more unboxed products under an order line. If blind_batch_box_results is non-empty, the platform processes it and ignores blind_box_results. Buyers can then view the unboxing results in the order details.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
main_order_id string N 576461413038785752 The unique identifier for a TikTok Shop order.
blind_box_results []object N When using the legacy result shape, provide unboxing results for one or more blind-box line items in the specified order.
^order_line_id string N 577086512123755123 The TikTok Shop line item ID for the blind box in the specified order.
^blind_result_product_id string N 1732042550463074704 The TikTok Shop product ID revealed by opening the blind box.
^blind_result_sku_id string N 1732042694638604688 The TikTok Shop SKU ID revealed by opening the blind box.
^blind_open_time int N 1762782183118 Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the blind box was opened.
blind_batch_box_results []object N Unboxing batch results for line items under orders.
^order_line_id string N 577086512123755123 The TikTok Shop line item ID of the blind box in the specified order to which this batch unboxing result belongs.
^blind_box_order_line_list []object N Unboxing results for line items under orders. on batch box version
^^blind_result_product_id string N 1732042550463074704 The TikTok Shop product ID revealed for this item in the batch unboxing result.
^^blind_result_sku_id string N 1732042694638604688 The TikTok Shop SKU ID revealed for this item in the batch unboxing result.
^^blind_open_time int N 1762782183118 Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the blind box was opened.
^^product_type string N NORMAL Unboxing product type.
Possible values:
  • NORMAL: A normal unboxed product.
  • GIFT: A gift unboxed product. |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/order/202605/orders/blind_box_result/callback?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY
